title: What Should a Self-Teacher See? Privileged Context Design for On-Policy Self-Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2609.25623v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: More privileged information does not always make a better teacher. We study this tension in on-policy self-distillation (OPSD), where a frozen copy of the base model scores the student's own rollouts under privileged context, conventionally a complete reference solution that bundles the final answer with one particular reasoning path. Holding the student view and training fixed within each scale, we compare that default against three abstractions compiled offline, a named strategy, a method-independent framing, and a problem category, and against an answer-only control that keeps the destination but removes the path. In the primary runs on competition mathematics, the best intermediate contexts improve the in-domain peak mean over the full solution by 1.4 points at 4B and 1.6 at 8B, while storing an order of magnitude fewer hint tokens. Comparisons across three seeds also show positive mean gains for the framing and category contexts at

translated_title: 自教师应该看到什么？面向在线策略自蒸馏的特权上下文设计
translated_abstract: 更多的特权信息并不总能造就更好的教师。我们在在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）中研究这一矛盾：在该框架下，基础模型的一个冻结副本在特权上下文下对学生自身生成的采样结果进行评分，而传统的特权上下文是一个完整的参考解答，它将最终答案与某一条特定的推理路径捆绑在一起。在每个规模下保持学生视图和训练设置固定不变的情况下，我们将这一默认设置与三种离线编译的抽象形式进行比较——命名策略、方法无关的框架以及问题类别——并与仅保留答案的对照组进行比较，后者保留了目的地但移除了路径。在竞赛数学的主要实验中，最佳的中间上下文在4B规模上将域内峰值均值比完整解答提高了1.4分，在8B规模上提高了1.6分，同时所需的提示词元存储量少了一个数量级。跨三个随机种子的比较还显示，框架和类别上下文在……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 在在线策略自蒸馏中，精心设计的抽象特权上下文（如命名策略、方法无关框架或问题类别）比捆绑具体推理路径的完整参考解答更有效，能在竞赛数学任务上以少一个数量级的提示存储量取得更高的学生模型性能。
en_tdlr: In on-policy self-distillation, well-designed abstract privileged contexts (such as named strategies, method-independent framings, or problem categories) outperform complete reference solutions bundled with specific reasoning paths, improving student performance on competition math while storing an order of magnitude fewer hint tokens.
